t13892:
Whenever I go shopping, everyone
always throws in a little something extra.
It makes me so happy, I can't help taking it.
I'll have to repay them with service at the tavern!
t13893:
Getting to enjoy a festival dressed up
as someone else is so much fun, isn't it?
If we did this in Orario, everyone would dress up
and it'd be even more fun!
t13894:
There are so many costumes, I can't decide!
If I'm feeling daring, maybe I'll be a werewolf
and gobble somebody up?
Like...Bell, for instance. Ahaha!
t13895:
I usually work at the tavern,
so it feels like a break from the bustle.
The tavern's chatter is nice,
but the quiet out here isn't bad either.
t13896:
It feels really good!
It's cute, and I can move around just fine.
I could probably wait tables in it!
Should I actually try that sometime?
t13897:
Oh my, you beat me to it!
...Just kidding! I figured you'd say that,
so I prepared a few sweets.
They're just test batches, but here!
t13899:
Don't you feel like you can be a little bolder...
a little freer than usual?
Hehe, I want to do lots of fun things.
t13900:
I want Bell to see it... What will he say?
I agonized over it a lot while picking this swimsuit.
I hope he likes it.
t13901: Q: What do you think of the "Sword Princess"?
t13902:
...The Loki Familia are wonderful regulars who always patronize our shop.
Yes. That's all... It's not like I have any feelings about her. Not one tiiiiiiny bit!
t13903:
I'm so happy I get to play with everyone.
But...if I join a game about reading people's hearts, I'd break the game.
I suppose the downside is I have to find another way to enjoy it?
t13904:
Orario finally has a pool, so I'd love to go swimming with everyone.
Maybe invite Mama Mia too... Hehe, don't you want to see Mama Mia in a swimsuit?
t13905: Q: What's your favorite date spot?
t13906:
As long as I'm with Bell, anywhere...would surely be the best date spot.
Hehe, I wonder where Bell will take me next?
t13907: Q: Do you think heroes exist?
t13908:
Somewhere out there... I've always hoped
I could meet my Óðr... my one and only hero.
t13909: Q: Your feelings for The Benevolent Mistress
t13910:
They're very, very dear friends...
But...the same days can't last forever.
When the "someday" I fear comes...I...
t13911: Q: What do you like about Ryu?
t13912:
She's clumsy... noble, and can be beautiful for someone else's sake.
That's why I love Ryu so much.
t13913: Q: What do you like about Bell?
t13914: His smile when I hand him a lunch box. The cute way he blushes so easily. But also how strong he is at heart, how he never breaks and keeps pushing forward even when he's lost... There's so much... I couldn't possibly pick just one.
t13915:
Th-they're all so cute...!
Mikoto, Haruhime... everyone...
And Orario is a big city...so
it's full of beautiful people... Hauu... I'm jealous.
t13916:
L-Level 100...!
That's so far from me, I can't even imagine it...
We're both adventurers, but we're so different...
Sigh... I wish I could be like that...
t13917:
Unlike me, Mikoto is so much stronger...
She's clear-spoken...and knows who she is.
She's a friend from home I can rely on.
And...we talk things over with each other.
t13918: Q: Something that made you happy recently
t13919:
When Ouka said the food I made
was delicious, I guess...
I worked hard and got up early
to make it, so I was really, really happy...!
t13920: Q: Something you'd like to change about yourself
t13921:
I d-don't really like how shy I am,
so I'd like to fix that if I can...
I wish I could be cheerful and friendly
like the girls at The Benevolent Mistress...
t13922:
D-do I really have to answer...?
...Uu, um... I-it's Ouka.
Ouka always leads me and Mikoto,
and I think he's really, r-really cool...!
t13923:
A Familia full of oblivious people
...would be a lot of trouble, I think.
I mean, Mikoto and I are going through it right now!
Everything's best in moderation...!
t13925:
He's always there to support us...
Like a pillar you want to lean on.
That hasn't changed since the Far East,
and I'm sure it never will...
t13926:
I was thinking of doing some weapons training.
Today...yeah, I'll practice with a katana.
I want to be able to use any weapon
when it counts, so...
t13928:
Lord Takemikazuchi works so hard
just to help with our funds.
He's probably frying Jyaga Maru-kun right now.
I help him out sometimes too.
t13929:
It was s-so far from my world...
I was really nervous...
But since everyone was there,
I think I had as much fun as I was nervous.
t13930:
Um... It's a wonderful outfit...
that gives even someone like me
a little bit of confidence...
Like it cast a spell on me.
t13931:
The people at the ball are amazing...
They don't get nervous at all, and dance so gracefully...
Is that what being an adult is like...?
I kind of admire it.
t13932:
Mikoto and Haruhime...
and Lady Hestia and the others
gave me advice, just for my sake...
I was so...so happy...
t13933:
...My heart feels warm.
Surrounded by kind people and dear friends...
and...Ouka is here too...
Is this what they call happiness...? Hehe.
t13934:
I think Lady Mikoto is very adorable.
Especially when she's speaking with Lord Takemikazuchi,
her usual dignity vanishes
and she becomes a sweet young maiden.
t13935:
I imagine they'd be very rugged.
Wild and fierce,
the sort who'd tear everything apart...!
Just like someone out of a story...!
t13936:
My feelings?! For Master Bell?!
Well, um, gratitude for saving me,
and his lovely collarbones, and staying by his side...
I-I'm sorry, I can't put it all together!
t13937:
Lady Mikoto is so skilled at chores and cooking
that I try to imitate her.
But...she moves so fast
that I'm still working on just following her with my eyes...
t13938: Q: Any tips for winning a man's heart?
t13939:
Kyan?! I don't know any such tips...
According to the Amazons,
you just hug him and use a sweet voice...
I-I could never do that!
t13940:
That would be...Master Bell.
Master Bell is like the heroic tales I've read—
no, he's a hero with even greater courage...
my very own hero, who saved me.
t13941:
Someone as weak as me
could never presume to say such a thing...
...But if I may wish for something,
a Familia without Master Bell would be lonely.
t13943:
Lady Aisha's words are a bit rough,
but she was always kind and caring
toward me, a useless courtesan.
She's truly like a big sister to me.
t13945:
Th-this is rather shameful, but
while doing the laundry, I secretly
gave Master Bell's clothes a little...squeeze...
H-how could someone like me do such a thing...!
t13946:
Today I'll take care of the laundry and cleaning.
Oh, and massage Lady Hestia's shoulders.
She seems to get very stiff shoulders.
Mine get stiff too, so I'd love to find a fix.
t13947:
It was so big and grand...
I was completely overwhelmed.
Will there be more places like that?
I'm really looking forward to it.
t13948:
I heard that eating meat and veggies
in swimsuits in the heat—a "barbecue"—is the best!
So I'd love to try it with everyone in the Familia.
I'm sure it'll be fun. Ufufu.
t13949:
...I hoped it would please Master Bell,
so I worked up the courage to wear it...
Oh my, how bold of me...!
Please forget I said that...!
t13950: Q: Who would look great at the pool?
t13951:
...M-Master Bell, perhaps?
His healthy, lean build
and innocent smile would shine on the water...
I think it would suit him very well.
t13952: Q: What makes you happy lately?
t13953:
When I'm doing the laundry, I think.
The wet laundry is so cool and pleasant,
and seeing the clean clothes feels wonderful.
In that moment, the heat just melts away.
t13954:
We have similar events in the Far East,
but I see there are many kinds of dances...
I feel as if I've glimpsed
a new side of Orario.
t13955:
As befits formal wear,
it's gorgeous yet dignified.
...Though mine seems a bit flashy,
and rather revealing... Am I overthinking it?
t13956:
The dances of Orario are...simply lovely.
Bodies close together to the music, amid a crowd,
sharing a sweet, passionate time for two alone...
Just thinking about it makes my heart burn...
t13957: Q: Something fun you did recently
t13958:
Before the ball, Lady Chigusa, Lady Mikoto,
and others with someone they love
and I had some "girl talk"!
It was ever so much fun!
t13959:
I spent a truly wonderful time
at the ball.
Though...would it be selfish of me
to wish I'd danced with Master Bell a bit longer...?
t13960:
I'd put forward Liliruca Arde.
She knows her own weakness, yet has a strong will.
She carries great courage in a small body.
As a fellow Prum, I'm proud of her.
t13961:
Would they all be strong and silent like Ottar?
I don't think I could command that lot.
I'm not even sure I could talk to them.
As a commander, I'd still like to try, though.
t13962:
She's an interesting god, hard to pin down.
Personally, I wouldn't recommend
worshipping Loki blindly.
That said, I do trust her.
t13963:
I was thinking of maintaining my weapons.
Even if I'm not a smith, the one wielding them
should at least handle the basics, right?
It's a surprisingly enjoyable time. Ahaha.
t13964: Q: What are you grateful for day to day?
t13965:
I'm grateful to everyone in the Familia
for following someone like me as captain.
Of course, to live up to their feelings,
I intend to lead this Familia with all I've got.
t13966:
I think it's a fine event.
The whole town gets lively and energized.
It's a little embarrassing to admit...
but even I get a bit carried away. Haha.
t13967:
Hmm, let's see.
An unimaginable idea that impresses everyone,
a flash of insight that overturns common sense...
That's the kind of inspiration I'd want.
t13969:
...I have to say I don't know.
I haven't reached the answer yet.
Meticulous design? Bold interpretation?
Tell me... What is art...?!
t13971:
Our members have strong personalities,
so they're not easy to handle...but that's fine.
That's what makes us the Loki Familia,
and what makes being captain worthwhile.
t13972:
Let's see, Riveria and Gareth?
They seem to have plenty of room to spare.
Maybe I'll split my work between them...
Just kidding, of course. Haha.
t13973:
Depends how you define cool, but Finn, perhaps.
Women gossip about him just walking down the street,
and every time, Tione bites their heads off.
Well, it's a familiar sight.
t13974:
Barbaric dwarves, cheeky Prums,
and a slovenly god to top it off—no thank you.
...Or so I thought.
Now, it's surprisingly not so bad.
t13975:
She's grown strong, but is still naive about the world,
and just as childish as ever...
She's a handful I still can't take my eyes off.
...Truly, she keeps me busy. Hehe.
t13977:
Plenty of them are quirky, to say the least,
and they make a racket everywhere, every day.
A handful? More like impossible to handle.
At least they behave in the Dungeon.
t13978: Q: What's been troubling you lately?
t13979:
It's about Lefiya.
She seems a bit too fixated on Ais.
If she starts being reckless like Ais... Sigh.
I must raise her so that doesn't happen.
t13980:
Ais and Lefiya are still young.
It may be a fine place for them to play...
but I have no need for it.
I can bathe on my own just fine.
t13981:
Nothing in particular for myself.
If anything, I'd have liked to see
Ais and Lefiya playing at the pool a little more.
Making memories like that matters too.
t13982:
...Loki got the better of me again.
That's all there is to it.
I have nothing to say about my swimsuit.
So I'd appreciate it if you dropped the subject.
t13984:
I thought Loki was once again
sinking a fortune into something frivolous.
Still, she's probably turned a profit.
She truly is unfathomable.
t13985: Q: Tips for beating the heat
t13986:
It depends on the heat, but with the right mindset
you can manage to a degree.
Whatever the circumstances,
keep your mind calm and unshaken.
t13987:
A fine festival.
Just listening to the laughter
from all over the city is pleasant.
t13988:
Nothing in particular...
but if it's given from the heart,
I'd be glad to receive it.
Wouldn't you agree?
t13989:
Speaking as a viewer,
it's reading the creator's intent and feelings,
and being moved—to empathy, sometimes rejection.
Something like that, perhaps?
t13990: Q: Which do you prefer, cold or heat?
t13991:
I'm not fond of either,
but cold is the lesser evil.
You can bundle up against the cold,
which is more than you can do for heat.
t13992:
Hmm, a gift... For once,
I'd like to give Eina something.
The Guild must be hard on her, yet she does well.
Perhaps I'll invite her to dinner sometime.
t13993:
The coolest is Bell!
I caused him so much trouble,
but Bell still smiled at me.
When Bell smiles, it's super warm!
t13994:
Familia... You mean Bell and everyone, right?
There's nothing I don't like!
Everyone's nice and warm...
So it's not bad at all—I love it!
t13995:
When I was all alone and lonely,
Bell hugged me and saved me.
So next time, I'll save Bell!
I'm gonna give Bell a big hug!
t13997:
Once, when we played hide-and-seek,
I hid in Bell's room,
and it smelled a lot like Bell, you know?
I felt safe and fell asleep...and got found.
t13999:
I'm helping out with Mikoto and Haruhime!
We fold everyone's laundry together
and clean up the house.
It's super fun and really rewarding!
t14000:
...Lady Hephaistos, I'd say.
She's a beautiful goddess,
but I think she's cute when she smiles.
Not many people know that side of her, though.
t14001:
One with its own top-tier smith on hand!
No, maybe a smith even better than that.
...So I can become that someday,
both Bell and I have to work hard!
t14003:
She's a wall I have to surpass—
incredibly high and thick.
She's not called the divine smith for nothing... I know.
But I still want to surpass her, no matter what.
t14005:
A forge is a great place, I think.
You pit your own heat against the weapon's,
climbing higher and higher...
You can only taste that here. Isn't it great?
t14006:
Thought I'd take a tour around the city today.
If I just stay holed up in the forge,
I feel like there are things I'll miss.
And if I find good materials, that's a bonus!
t14007:
Might be rude to say about a god,
but it's Lady Hephaistos.
Someday I'll surpass her too.
...Don't tell her I said that, okay?
t14008:
I'm done being forced to make magic swords.
Magic swords that vanish and leave adventurers behind—
I can't like them, and I don't want to make them.
Weapons should always support adventurers.
t14009:
Out of dozens, hundreds of pieces of gear on display,
he chose the armor I forged.
I was happy. Really, truly happy.
That's why I want to repay Bell.
t14011:
Leave it to me! Smith's creed, number one!
Strike while the iron and your spirit are hot!
Whatever it is, while you're still fired up,
go for it and give it a shot!
t14013:
I tried making a weapon, but the balance is off...
Is it the hilt? Or the blade...?
Hmm... I'm starting to lose track.
Would you give it a test run for me?
t14014:
As a smith, all I can feel is gratitude.
Those guys risk their lives digging up the ore
that lets us forge weapons.
t14015:
Can't believe so many greedy-eyed folks
gathered in Golden.
Well, anyone who gets fired up about something
and charges ahead—I don't mind 'em.
t14016: Q: What do you want from Golden?
t14017:
Honestly, rather than gold, I'd be happier
if even one rare metal
for weapons and armor turned up.
But it's for the Familia.
I'll put my back into the digging.
t14018:
Well...
They say his followers adore him, right?
Maybe he's got some good points after all.
t14019: Q: If Hephaistos were an ore, what would she be?
t14020:
Lady Hephaistos is... let's see.
Ultra-hard adamantite,
I'd say.
Sturdy and honest. Hardly anything
can shake her.
The exact opposite of flashy gold.
t14021:
Judging from what the customers who visit our shop say,
I believe the gods are quite good-looking.
Lord Takemikazuchi, Lord Miach... even Lord Dian Cecht... see?
t14022:
I'd dislike a Familia that doesn't take care of its body or can't look after itself.
Let alone a Familia that would raise a hand against the gravely wounded.
t14023:
Nahza Erisuis... is it...?
She's always making snide remarks at me,
but I'll admit she's skilled.
t14024:
The Loki Familia is one of our biggest clients.
They always bring in high-quality items, which helps us greatly,
but negotiating with Ms. Tione is a bit of a chore.
t14026:
Rare drop items are essential for developing new medicine.
If you have any rare drop items, we can purchase them as well.
Depending on the item, we'll pay more than anyone else, so please consult us.
t14027: Q: Give us the city's fastest tongue twister
t14028:
A pig poked a pig, so the poked pig poked back, and the poking pig and the poked pig po—ngh?!
What are you making me do? I'll kill you.
t14029:
I couldn't care less about anything to do with the Familia.
The only one I follow is her.
t14031:
It's just a post that got shoved on me.
But...if this is "proof" of strength, I'll surpass the captain—that guy—no matter what.
t14032:
Arrogant, cold-hearted... stronger than anyone.
Nothing like that "girl"—
she's the one and only goddess I call my master.
t14034:
I...abandoned that "dimwit."
There's nothing left to say.
Now, I'm her "chariot" alone.
t14035:
I think everyone in the Familia is cute.
Lefiya, Tione, Tiona...
They seem even cuter when they smile.
Would I...be cuter if I smiled too?
t14036:
Hmm... They seem like they'd be good with weapons,
so they probably wouldn't break any.
Weapons break fast when I use them...
If they really existed, I'd want to ask for tips.
t14037:
Lefiya is still a little reckless,
but she works hard, so she'll get strong.
Also, she pays attention to someone like me,
and her funny faces sometimes are amusing.
t14039:
Drop items are a problem.
I have tons piled up, but don't use them much.
If I keep not using them,
the home will get buried... That's a problem.
t14040:
I'm thinking about how to get stronger.
What if I became like Gareth?
Gareth is tough and has amazing muscles.
If I built muscles like Gareth...
t14041:
Hmm... Riveria, maybe?
I often hear people say she's cool.
Honestly, I don't really get that stuff.
Being cool is hard.
t14042:
I wouldn't like not having friends I can trust.
I'm not strong... But when everyone's here,
I feel like I can be a little stronger than usual.
So I've come to think my friends are precious.
t14043:
Bell is a really mysterious boy.
He's getting stronger faster than anyone. Amazing.
The way he only looks forward is dazzling.
I can't take my eyes off him... That's the mystery.
t14044:
Today, I'm planning to go to the Dungeon.
I kind of...need a lot of money.
There's Desperate's repair bill,
and paying for the weapons I broke, and more.
t14046:
Today's pick is Pistachio Cream flavor.
The pistachio-scented cream
and the original Jyaga Maru-kun taste are perfect together.
You should try it... *munch munch*
t14047:
I'm not very good with water...
But the pool has spots where my feet touch the bottom.
Even though it's water, I had fun.
...I hope I keep getting used to it like this.
t14048:
I want to try making chilled Jyaga Maru-kun...
It was so good.
If I ask Riveria to chill it even more,
it might be even tastier...
t14049:
It's cool and easy to move in, I guess?
But if I move too hard, it might come off. That worries me.
And it's white, so I can't get it dirty.
...Swimsuits are kind of hard to wear.
t14050: Q: How do you spend hot days?
t14051:
Um, same as always, I guess.
I can move even when it's hot,
so I go to the Dungeon, or train...
But sweating more is a little annoying.
t14052: Q: What if you had to fight by the water?
t14053:
...I'd avoid fighting as much as possible.
There's not much need to fight by the water.
...If I really have to fight,
I'll have to be ready...
t14054:
It's cold outside, and the snow is chilly,
but lots of people gather together,
and it feels like everyone's smiling.
Strange... But I think it's really nice.
t14055:
Jyaga Maru-kun would be good.
Jyaga Maru-kun is great any time,
but it's really tasty this time of year.
So I'd be really happy to get some...!
t14056:
Um... It's hard for me.
I don't really understand it...
But when I see things other people made,
I do go "ooh," I guess?
t14057: Q: About something that made you happy
t14058:
It's getting cold, so
Lefiya, Tiona, Tione, and I
promised to go shopping for warm clothes.
...I'm looking forward to going together again.
t14059:
Riveria, maybe? But also
Lefiya, Tiona, Tione...
and then... yeah.
I want to give something to everyone in the Familia, I think.
t14060: Someone pure... honest, and who can still stay close to someone's side... I think that's, um, cool.
t14061:
We don't need a Familia, right...?
As long as I'm here, that's enough, right...?
That's what "love" is, right...?
t14062:
I have no one but my darling.
And my darling has no one but me.
This is what "mutual love" is, right...?
t14063:
About my darling...?
Why should I tell you?
Don't tell me YOU'RE also... UNFORGIVABLE.
t14064:
Anywhere is fine...
What matters isn't "where," it's "with my darling"...
But the deep floors of the Dungeon might be nice. No one to get in the way...
t14065:
Like, a story about spirits...maybe?
And one with a happy ending... please.
I'd like to see one in Ms. Harmonia's plays again.
t14066:
NO MATTER WHAT BECOMES OF ME, I SHALL KEEP SINGING.
AT THE SIDE OF THE HERO CADMUS.

Ms. Harmonia, was it...like this?
t14067:
Someone who loves Jyaga Maru-kun... a Jyaga Mate?
I don't think anyone who likes Jyaga Maru-kun can be a bad person.
t14068:
A lively...god?
And a god who cares about her familia, I think.
t14069:
HELLO... I AM EVERYONE'S IDOL, AIS.
A LOVE ANGEL WHO KEEPS FIGHTING TO DELIVER LOVE TO EVERYONE.
PLEASE KEEP SUPPORTING ME.

Um... Loki said I should say that.
t14070: I'd like to go to the Sword City... Solingen. I wonder if they have a sword that never breaks...and never dulls, no matter how much I use it...
t14071: Q: About the special New Year's Jyaga Maru-kun flavor
t14072:
Toasty and rich... a mysterious flavor?
It's really good...
Is this...a Far Eastern flavor?
t14073:
Everyone playing tag around the city together... That might be fun?
I want to come in first...and go to the Sword City, Solingen.
t14075:
She's a really precious friend... and family.
I'm glad Lefiya joined the Loki Familia.
t14076:
...I want to get stronger.
To protect my precious...friends.
t14077: Q: What are you into lately?
t14078:
Jyaga Maru-kun, Magical Sweet flavor...
A Jyaga Maru-kun that goes all in on sweetness. Perfect for a snack.
I want to eat it with the girl who came up with the magical girl...
t14079:
She always talks to me... a precious family member who's really good to me?
When she hugs me...it's a little, embarrassing, though.
t14080:
A magical girl... something really warm and kind?
Magic that makes everyone happy... I think it's nice.
t14082:
Something Riveria and everyone... so many people have given me, I think.
It's something very precious.
t14083:
On a moonlit night, to stop Vanargand, apostle of darkness, on a rampage of destruction,
I race through the darkness. Will the flower of love bloom in chaotic Orario?
Next time: "The Rampaging Werewolf." Ready, together... Magical Change, Lovely Blue.
t14085:
Our "Infinite Teamwork" can overturn even a Level gap.
With all four of us together... we have no intention of losing even to that self-appointed Prum representative, Braver.
t14086:
We swear loyalty to only one deity. Lady Freya alone.
If Lady Freya orders it, we'll fight side by side with the others... but in the end, they're all enemies vying for Lady Freya's favor, you could say.
t14087:
No need to even ask.
The one and only, most beloved goddess, descended from the heavens.
Her soul and her form are more beautiful than anything in this world.
If anyone tried to harm her... I would "never" forgive them.
t14088: Q: What do you want most right now?
t14089:
All we seek is...Lady Freya's favor.
As long as we have that, we need nothing else.
t14090: Q: Who's the coolest of the Bringar?
t14091:
We might look identical at first glance, but the dignity of the eldest brother just...oozes out of me, so I'm the coolest, wouldn't you say?
Oh... My brothers are cursing me over there.
t14092:
They're from my homeland, but
perhaps Lady Chigusa or Lady Haruhime?
They both have a loveliness I lack.
Honestly, I'm a little envious.
t14093:
Soaking in the finest hot springs every day!
Or enjoying secret baths found only in the deep floors,
or even making a hot spring of our own!
Aah! How wonderful, I'm so envious!
t14095:
He took me in when I had no one.
He is my patron god, my family, and my master—
someone very, very dear to me.
...Though his obliviousness is complicated.
t14097:
I adore hot springs, but
do you know the etiquette for bathing in one?
If not, I'll teach you!
Now, now, first let's take off your clothes!
t14098: Q: Something you can't help thinking about lately
t14099:
Lord Takemikazuchi... I suppose?
What he's doing right now,
or whether he's talking with some woman...
...P-please forget that nonsense!
t14100:
T-T-Ta-ta...!
Ta-ta-ta-Takemikazuchi! It's him!
Eh, why do I think so?!
...Please spare me any more, I beg you!
t14101:
No hot spring bathing... Guhaa!
Not being able to soak in the life-giving waters that melt away fatigue...
Just imagining it drains my stamina to the limit,
and my Mind would run dry too...
t14102:
Sir Bell is a big-hearted person.
He didn't blame us for our great mistake—
he understood, and forgave us with a smile.
I want to work hard to become like him.
t14103:
My daily routine, you ask?
I never neglect maintaining my weapons.
"Treasure the gear that protects your life and your comrades'"...
It's a precious lesson from Lord Takemikazuchi.
t14104:
Today is my training day with Lord Ouka!
A mighty heavy blow that would cleave through anything...
Would I block it, or parry it...?
Just imagining it is kind of fun.
t14105:
To build something like a lake...
The Loki Familia is formidable indeed.
Thanks to them, I had fun despite the heat!
Someday I'd like to invite them to a cypress bath as thanks.
t14106:
I know it's impossible, but
someday, someday I want to run on water...!
I heard the fairy tales Lady Haruhime reads
include legends of ninja who could.
t14107:
It's easy to move in, and cool,
and I can splash water on myself in it,
so it's perfect for training on hot days!
...Eh, that's not the kind of review you meant?
t14109:
No, not allowed, absolutely unthinkable!
Bathing is about setting yourself free
and healing the fatigue piled on body and mind...
In other words, true bathing means going in naked!
t14111:
Training with water... I see.
It's true that in water, just moving
puts more strain on you than usual.
As long as it's not a hot spring, it might be good.
t14112:
Everyone looks so happy, and it's so lively.
I think it's a truly wonderful event.
I hope the children at the shrine get to know this fun someday.
t14113: Q: Is there anything you'd like to try?
t14114:
I hear people like to eat "cay-kuh" at the Holy Night Festival?
I'd like to learn to make it well so I can serve it to Sir Bell and the others.
t14115:
The gift that made me happiest would be... the dagger Chizan that Lord Takemikazuchi gave me.
So I can be someone Lord Takemikazuchi, who waits for my return, can be proud of, I want to walk the righteous path at all times.
t14116: Q: About the bunny girl outfit
t14117:
It's embarrassing, but desperate times call for desperate measures!
Aiming for 1,000,000 valis, I'll make the most of this getup and simply charge forward!
t14118:
When it comes to giving gifts to those who look after me, there are just too many people I want to give to...
Above all, I want to give Lord Takemikazuchi an exceptional gift worthy of the great kindness he's shown me.
t14119:
I love the tale of the first hero—Argonaut, I guess?
Some people badmouth him as a lame hero, but honestly, that's what makes him cute...
Hehe. I'd love to play him someday~.
t14120:
An evil dragon came out of the Dungeon?
Pfft... In the hands of me, the diva of the age who overcame despair, that's a piece of cake.
Spirits, heroes, all of you, follow me!
...How's that? My own take on the ancient diva.
t14121: Q: Your feelings for Bell and Ais
t14122:
Once I talked to them, they were totally different from what the rumors made them sound like?
I thought the Sword Princess would be a scarier battle maniac, and the Little Rookie a wilder, sketchier adventurer.
They're really fun kids!
t14123:
She's tactless and loud, a total klutz and selfish... seriously one ridiculous airhead goddess.
But I can't take my eyes off her—that's a goddess of beauty for you. As an actress, there may be things I can learn from her.
t14124:
I have nothing but gratitude. It's because you're all here that I'm... yeah.
...Forget it. A canned interview won't get anything across.
All you identical-looking vegetables out there—thank you for "keeping me here"!
t14125: Q: Which title do you think is cool?
t14126:
Th-the gods have bestowed a fearsome name indeed with Zetsu†Ei.
Yet... it cannot match my soul's true name, Dainsleif.
t14127:
A garden of war dyed red by the "Baptism."
I-it is a place fit for my black soul of chaos to dwell.
t14128: Th-the accursed white rabbit who seeks to beguile my goddess... was what I thought... but when I actually talked to him, he's a pretty good guy... Maybe we could even be friends...?! No, no, no way...
t14129:
Lady Freya...saved us from that place.
So this soul belongs entirely to Lady Freya.
For Lady Freya's sake, I'd do...anything.
t14131: Wh-why does everyone call me that...? I don't have some weird disease, and it feels like they're totally making fun of me... so please stop...
t14132: The incompetent, the inefficient dimwits, all the inferior trash overflowing in this world—their very existence is a sin.
t14133:
In a word, a herd of base battle-crazed fools and zealots, vying to receive her "favor."
Yet that very state is what makes us stronger still.
t14134:
To receive her favor, that foolish rabbit is lacking in every way imaginable.
No matter how much I remodel him, it's never enough.
But...he never betrays expectations. That much deserves credit.
t14135:
My loyalty exists for her alone.
If necessary, I will cut away and discard everything else.
t14136: Q: What matters most as a commander?
t14137: Many talents are required... but first, a dimwit whose fear dulls their decisions has no right to command.
t14138:
I'm not that into cool, meow~
Hmm, Mama Mia, maybe, meow?
She's stronger and tougher than most adventurers,
so you could call her cool, nya?
t14139:
A Familia with an age limit is a no-go, meow.
Especially if it bans little ones, that's the end, meow.
But letting cute kids get into danger
is even worse, meow... Wh-what a tough problem, meow!
t14141:
Mama Mia's cooking is super delicious, meow!
But she's crazy scary when she's mad, meow.
So you shouldn't make her mad too often, meow.
She's the strongest mama, so it can't be helped, meow~
t14143:
Everyone at the tavern is a weirdo, meow.
And then weird adventurers show up too,
so it's hopeless, meow. It turns into another world, meow.
Well, that's fun too, meow~ Nyufufu.
t14144:
Finding cuties and observing them...
That's one thing I do every day without fail, meow.
Of course I'm observing the boy too, meow.
Watching him grow is part of the job, meow~
t14145:
Nobody I'd call cool, really.
People with strong fists are cool, I guess?
I mean, when it counts, you've gotta be able
to fight for yourself and get through a crisis.
t14146:
I wouldn't want to fight a strong Familia.
Familias like that show no mercy at all.
...Oh, I talked like fighting was a given,
but it doesn't mean anything, ahaha, ahaha!
t14147:
Man, she's amazing—those fists and that nerve.
She's strong, she's big, I don't stand a chance.
And on top of that, she's a great cook.
Of course I look up to her~
t14149:
You'd think the ones slacking off
are those dumb cats, Anya and Chloe,
but actually Syr, and then Ryu,
are away from the shop the most. Fun fact.
t14151:
Work is the tough part, really...
Anya and Chloe are always sloppy,
and Syr and Ryu disappear pretty often,
so in the end, all the work falls on me...
